# Deploy an internal app built with Claude Code, Cursor or Codex

> A practical guide to deploying an internal app that an AI coding agent built, with Stacksync Enterprise OS and the EOS CLI. Short answer: install the CLI, sign in first with `eos auth login` so the app is not public, run `eos deploy --dry-run`, then `eos deploy`. Apps deployed without signing in go to a public guest workspace that expires after 14 days. No GitHub repository is required. Includes prompts for coding agents, a preflight checker and example apps.

Stacksync Enterprise OS: https://www.stacksync.com/enterprise-os
Official docs: https://docs.stacksync.com/enterprise-os
Agent instructions: https://enterprise-os.stacksync.ai/skill.md
Stacksync: https://www.stacksync.com
